beats.text: Instagram was a giant that Facebook swallowed.
beats.note: It was a three year old company with 13 employees.

beats.context: The number of employees at Instagram when Facebook agreed to buy it in April 2012.

beats.text: About $1 billion in cash and stock.
beats.note: NPR attributes the figure to Forbes. Al Jazeera reports it as $1bn.

beats.text: That is roughly $77 million for every employee.
beats.note: This is $1 billion divided by 13, rounded.

beats.text: More than 25 million people already used it.
beats.note: That is the user figure Al Jazeera gave.

beats.text: The deal landed just weeks before Facebook's IPO.
beats.note: NPR reported it as coming just weeks before the share sale.

beats.text: Thirteen people, one app, and a billion dollars.
